result.text:
I made all three improvements in the image, and the 14 tests in `CoffeeShopTest` pass. The tests don't cover every change, though: the old `#Combo1`/`#Combo2` and `#Gold`/`#Silver`/`#Normal` symbols no longer work (see the last section).

**1. Duplicated code in tests 2 and 3.** I tried the "extract method from similar code" refactoring tool, but it broke the tests: it chose the wrong parameters, deleted `salesSystem := CoffeeShopSalesSystem new` and wrote `sself`. I removed what it created and wrote the new helper `assertOnlyOneSaleOf:wasMadeTo:` by hand. Test 2 now calls it once and test 3 calls it once per customer.

**2. Duplicated code in the last 6 tests.** `assertRewardOf:afterBuying:is:of:at:` sets up the sales system, records the purchases, gets the reward and checks its quantity, product and price. Two shorter helpers call it:
- `assertRule1RewardOf:is:at:` buys one Combo 1 and one Combo 2 and expects a quantity of 1.
- `assertRule2RewardOf:is:at:` buys two Combo 1 and one Combo 2 and expects a quantity of 2.

Each of tests 9–14 is now a single line. To make the product checkable with one helper, `isForCombo1` and `isForCombo2` on `CoffeeShopReward` became a single `isFor: aProduct`.

**3. `if`s replaced by polymorphism.**
- **Products:** I added `CoffeeShopProduct` with two subclasses, `CoffeeShopCombo1` and `CoffeeShopCombo2`. Each knows its own `price` and `volume`, and two products are equal when they are the same kind. This removed `CoffeeShopSalesSystem>>volumeOf:` and `RewardRule>>priceOf:`.
- **Customer types:** I added `CoffeeShopCustomerType` with `GoldCustomerType`, `SilverCustomerType` and `NormalCustomerType`. Each one answers `combo1RewardPrice` (75, 83 or 97 pesos) and `combo2RewardPriceFrom:` (50%, 75% or 90% of the regular price).
- **Reward rules:** each rule now only says its product, quantity and price (`rewardPriceFor:`). The two identical `createRewardFor:` methods were moved up into `RewardRule` with the push-up refactoring. The unused `product` instance variable was removed with the remove-variable refactoring.

**Other changes:**
- I moved `CoffeeShopTest` into `IngSof1-2019-2C-1Parcial-Tests`, as you asked. It had been in the main category.
- The tests now create customers with `GoldCustomerType new` and friends instead of `#Gold`, and `combo1`/`combo2` return product objects. Any code outside the tests that still passes the old symbols will stop working.
- Apart from the push-up and the variable removal, I made these changes by hand. The refactoring tools can't create new classes like these, and the one I did try broke the tests.

The changes are only in the running image: I haven't saved the image or the `IngSof1` package.
